jobs.title: Digital Mixed Signal Design and Modeling Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our team at Apple developing complex mixed-signal IPs for Apple’s custom integrated circuits. Our team has shipped hundreds of millions of chips into Apple’s existing product lines, and is developing new chips for future product lines!
In this role, you will create high-speed behavioral models for complex analog IPs that interface with digital control logic. Your models will “close the loop” in mixed-signal simulations, catch cross-domain bugs, and deliver 10x to 1000x speedups over transistor-level simulations—driving critical productivity gains across Apple's next-generation silicon roadmap. We are a prolific, diverse team looking for an enthusiastic engineer ready to build industry-leading products that surprise and delight our customers.
• Collaborate with system architects, analog designers, and digital teams to establish precise model specifications for mixed-signal IPs.
• Develop high-speed models from schematics and design specs.
• Build mixed-signal testbenches and integrate models into projects to close the simulation loop.
• Develop verification plans, run regression suites, and debug digital/analog corner cases.
• Correlate model accuracy and performance against transistor-level SPICE simulations.
• Drive modeling methodologies to accelerate simulation turnaround times and ensure tapeout readiness.
Minimum Qualifications
Minimum requirement of a bachelors degree
Preferred Qualifications
Experience developing digital logic or behavioral models for analog and mixed-signal circuits (e.g., SystemVerilog, Real Number Modeling / RNM, or Verilog-A/AMS).
Solid fundamentals in digital design and RTL development (SystemVerilog/Verilog).
Good knowledge of analog circuits and architectures (e.g., power converters, regulators, references, ADCs/DACs).
Experience with industry-standard simulation and verification tools (e.g., Xcelium, Virtuoso).
Strong debugging and cross-functional communication skills.

jobs.title: PMU Design Verification Engineer: Analog & Mixed Signal Engineer
jobs.description:
Did you know that Apple is hiring analog & mixed signal verification engineers? We are looking for engineers that are enthusiastic to find bugs! You have the opportunity to work with a creative team to craft test plans and enable production-quality first silicon. As a member of the analog and mixed signal verification team, you will be working with specialists for full-chip verification of the state of the art mixed-signal systems used in Apple’s world-leading products!
In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring high quality silicon for IC chips and IPs. Daily work involves verification of mixed signal IC designs using a combination of analog circuits and RTL in the same simulation. Responsibilities include all phases of pre-silicon verification from early discussions with architects, reviewing specifications, writing verification plans, running simulations, triaging issues, and reviewing results with the team.
• Develop detailed test and coverage plans based on IC specifications.
• Completion of verification plans from beginning to end: test bench and environment bring-up, regressions, failure debug, and tape-out.
• Develop verification methodology suitable for the IP, ensuring scalability and portability.
• Develop verification environment, including stimuli, checkers, assertions, trackers, and coverage.
• Sign-off mixed signal designs in preparation for tapeout.
Minimum Qualifications
BS and a minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Ability to verify analog/mixed-signal designs in a collaborative team environment.
Proficient in hardware descriptive languages: Verilog, System-Verilog, and/or Verilog-AMS code.
Familiarity with authoring analog assertion checks to catch bugs.
Capability to identify failure mechanisms and review verification results in analog IC designs.
Ability to write test plans, present results, and communicate clearly with multi-functional teams.
Comfortable with running simulations through compute clusters while optimizing simulation and wall time.
Understanding of both power management and related auxiliary circuitry: switching converters, linear converters, reference circuitry, bandgaps, data converters, and/or clock generators.
Have a familiarity with verification methodologies and tools: simulators, waveform viewers, execution automation, coverage collection, gate level simulations.
Experience developing scalable and portable test benches.
A background that includes scripting or programming languages is preferred. These include, but are not limited to, TCL, Skill, Python, and/or PERL.
Your familiarity with analog behavioral models is also a plus.

jobs.title: PMU Hardware Electrical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you interested in designing hardware as part of silicon development at Apple? Join our team at Apple developing custom mixed-signal integrated circuits for Apple’s existing and future product lines. Our small team has already shipped hundreds of millions of chips into several Apple product lines, including new products launched this year. We are looking for a hardworking engineer that is enthusiastic about embedded hardware design. You can work closely with a diverse and creative team to craft complex test systems for state-of-the-art power supplies. This role includes a broad scope of work including simulations, software, bringup, debug, extraction, and analysis. You will work closely with a wide range of people across functions and be a key contributor to the silicon development effort. Join us in building Apple’s next generation products. Do you want to be a part of building the “surprise and delight” in Apple’s future products?
In this exciting role you will be responsible for:
- Lab validation system design and development using circuits such as LDO, Buck, ADC, DAC, Op-AMP, FPGA etc., and control interface like I2C, SPI, SPMI, etc
- Circuit design, schematic, analysis, layout, and review in a PCB environment
- Knowledge of signal and power integrity (PDN analysis) is preferred
- Hands-on lab experience with hardware bring-up and debug
- Drive debug and resolution of engineering issues working with cross-functional teams.
- Experience with PCB manufacturing and assembly
Minimum Qualifications
BS and a minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience
Preferred Qualifications
MSEE preferred*
Experience with hardware development from specification to bring up and downstream support.
Skilled at component development and selection for schematics design
Ability to design or guide high quality PCB layouts into fabrication and assembly
Prior experience using CAD tools such as Cadence Allegro, Altium, etc for multi-layer board layout is desired
Familiarity with microcontroller/FPGA/logic design and programming
Skillful in an electronics lab environment using real time oscilloscopes, analyzers, function generators, automation hardware, power supplies, and electronic loads
Familiarity with challenges relating to power quality, high-speed signal integrity and control interface
Coding or automation experience in Python is a plus
Excellent written, verbal and communication skills focused on teamwork and collaboration in a dynamic cross-functional environment
